title: Extend or restart
notes: A = 3 −4 5 −2 −1 6 −7 2 1. The run drops to −1 after the −4, so it restarts at the 5. It crosses the dip of −2 and −1 (the run stays positive) and reaches 8 at the 6: A[2..5]. After the −7 the run is 1, still worth keeping, but never beats 8. 9 sums and 18 comparisons.
